rules: Headings (H1-H3) MUST use Chivo with uppercase/tracking-tight for dashboard sections to give a strong, tactical feel.
Body text MUST use IBM Plex Sans for maximum legibility of dense numbers and tabular data.
Thermal receipts and barcodes MUST use JetBrains Mono.
Hierarchy Gap Rule: Ensure contrast in font weights, use font-black for numbers, font-medium for labels.
Use 'Industrial Orange' (HSL: 24.6 95% 53.1%) as the primary action color (checkout, save, print).
Avoid 'SaaS Blue' or 'Teal'. Stick to Slate Greys and Orange to reflect the Garage/Automotive vibe.
Interactive states MUST have explicit hover and focus rings with high contrast.
Tint greys slightly blue (Slate) to make the UI look crisp and technical.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Neumorphism (Tactile Variant)' for quick-action buttons in POS. Use 'Grid Borders (Technical)' for data-dense tables.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp borders (border-border) for all table cells and cards to delineate data clearly.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Rely on 1px borders for structure to keep the interface fast and functional.
visual_enhancers.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). Best for dense data tools and garages.

component_patterns.navigation: Sidebar for Owner/Admin with fixed width. Top navigation or minimal sidenav for Kasir (to maximize screen space for POS cart).
component_patterns.pos_cart: High-density layout. Left side: Barcode scanner input, product search, received vehicles list. Right side: Current order cart, calculations, and massive Checkout button.
component_patterns.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Dense padding (p-2 or p-3). Zebra striping (bg-muted/50 on even rows) is RECOMMENDED for offline long reading.
component_patterns.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for checkout process (Tunai, QRIS, Debit, Credit, Transfer selection) and receipt preview.
component_patterns.receipt: A specialized hidden component that only appears during window.print() (via @media print).

grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Used for the Owner Dashboard (Today's Sales, Active Services, Low Stock Alerts).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing in Dashboard (p-6, p-8). Tight spacing in POS Kasir interface (p-2, p-4) to fit more items.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Numbers and prices MUST always be right-aligned in tables and receipts.

motion.micro_interactions: Snappy, fast transitions (0.15s ease). A cashier uses this daily, slow animations will frustrate them.
motion.toast: Use `sonner` for quick success/error notifications (e.g., 'Item added', 'Stock low').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Especially critical for offline garages which may have poor lighting or dirty screens.
accessibility.keyboard: CRITICAL: POS system must be keyboard-navigable. Barcode scanner acts as keyboard (sends barcode + Enter). Input fields must auto-focus where appropriate.

login_background.description: Red sport bike in garage. Use as a split-screen or full-background with heavy dark overlay (bg-slate-950/80) for the Login page.

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: React frontend, Tailwind, Shadcn UI. FastApi + MongoDB backend (offline local network deploy).
instructions_to_main_agent.barcode_handling: Install `react-barcode` or use `bwip-js` for generating barcode labels for items. Listen for 'Enter' keypress in search inputs to handle physical barcode scanner input automatically.
instructions_to_main_agent.thermal_printing: Create a specific CSS class `.print-only` visible only in `@media print`. Hide `.no-print`. Define `@page { margin: 0; }`. Provide toggle in Settings for paper width (58mm ~ 219px, 80mm ~ 302px).
instructions_to_main_agent.whatsapp_reminder: Construct links like: `https://wa.me/{phone}?text={encoded_message}`. Replace variables from Settings template.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_management: Use React Context or Zustand for the active POS cart and Kasir session.
instructions_to_main_agent.font_installation: Install font packages via yarn (`yarn add @fontsource/chivo @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans @fontsource/jetbrains-mono`) and import them in `index.js` or `App.js` to ensure they work OFFLINE.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Use `sonner` for toasts. Do NOT use standard `window.alert`. Provide fallback offline placeholders if any remote assets fail.

universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='btn-checkout'`).
universal_guidelines.anti_slop: Do not make generic centered layouts. Align forms left. Create depth with z-index and 1px borders instead of massive fuzzy shadows.
universal_guidelines.transparency: CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, dropdowns. Use solid backgrounds (bg-card) to avoid text collision.
universal_guidelines.design_language: This is a B2B tactical application for a motorcycle garage (bengkel). It must look sturdy, data-rich, and fast.
